text: Upon award of a contract action, including orders under multiple-award contracts, the SDVOSB or VOSB offeror must comply with VAAR subpart 819.70 and SBA regulations at 13 CFR part 121 and part 125, including the non-manufacturer rule and limitations on subcontracting (LOS) requirements in 13 CFR 121.406(b) and 13 CFR 125.6. Compliance with these LOS clauses must be asserted by the offeror in the email accompanying their quote. The limitations on subcontracting shall be applied as follows: (1) For services (except construction), the prime contractor shall not pay more than 50% of the amount paid by the government to the prime for contract performance to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs or VOSBs (excluding direct costs that are not the principal purpose of the acquisition and are not provided by the SDVOSB/VOSB, such as airline travel, cloud computing services, or mass media purchases); (2) For supplies or products (other than from a non-manufacturer), the prime contractor shall not pay more than 50% of the amount paid by the government to the prime for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs or VOSBs; (3) For supplies from a non-manufacturer, the prime contractor shall supply the product of a domestic small business manufacturer or processor, unless a waiver under 13 CFR 121.406(b)(5) is granted; (4) For general construction, the prime contractor shall not pay more than 85% of the amount paid by the government to the prime for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs or VOSBs; (5) For special trade construction contractors, no more than 75% of the amount paid by the government to the prime for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs or or VOSBs may be paid to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs or VOSBs. Compliance must be achieved by the end of the base term of the contract or order, and then by the end of each subsequent option period, or by the end of the performance period for each order issued under the contract. For supply or construction contracts, the cost of materials is excluded and not considered to be subcontracted. When a contract includes both services and supplies, the 50 percent limitation applies to the portion of the contract with the preponderance of the expenditure upon which the assigned NAICS is based.

text: The quoter must provide all required Sorna Vertex 25ei & CD Burner products in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW)(P13) by submitting a single quote presenting their best price and best terms.
